title: Nightshift
author: Pr1nted
$comment: The low end of the electronic set, sitting between the calm pool and the political middle. As delivered it was at (0.15, 0.45, 0.20), which won BOTH post-war rebuilding scenarios off Reprise -- a synth pad is the wrong answer to a country putting itself back together, so it moved up in tension and down in valence to clear that spot.
